Sprout Social is an enterprise social media management platform. Starting at $199/month per user, it gives marketing teams scheduling, analytics, social listening, and a unified inbox. But Sprout Social does not create a single piece of content. No graphics. No videos. No captions. You bring everything — it just pushes the button. And it is built for enterprise brands, not real estate agents.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

The core question: do you want to pay enterprise prices for a scheduling tool — then still hire a designer, video editor, and copywriter? Or do you want everything done for less? Here is how they compare.

Does Sprout Social create content for you?
No. Sprout Social is a scheduling and analytics platform. It does not design graphics, edit videos, or write captions. You create all content yourself or hire a separate team.
Is Sprout Social built for real estate agents?

No. Sprout Social is an enterprise social media management tool built for marketing teams, agencies, and large brands across all industries. It has no real estate-specific features, templates, or content.
Does Sprout Social include video editing?
No. Sprout Social can schedule video posts, but it does not edit video content. You need to edit videos yourself or hire a separate video editor.
What is Sprout Social’s Trustpilot rating?
Sprout Social has a 2.2 out of 5 rating on Trustpilot, rated “Poor.” Common complaints include high pricing, contract disputes, cancellation difficulties, and slow customer support.
Do I still need other tools if I use Sprout Social?

Yes. Sprout Social handles scheduling and analytics, but you still need a graphic designer or Canva, a video editor, a copywriter for captions, and potentially a social media strategist. That is 4+ additional tools or hires on top of Sprout Social’s per-user pricing.
